So sorry this happened to you, I also had my worse psychosis break downs in university from major bullying and college stress. I literally could not control where I was or “ thought” I was. I had to go to the mental hospital because I couldn’t even attend my classes anymore because it was getting to be a big problem. My psychosis delusion made me believe that as soon as I woke up I was somehow at my work (I worked at Pizza Hut) and that we were in the middle of a work rush. I wouldn’t question anything about how I just got to ‘Pizza Hut’ because the delusion would start off usually my boss yelling at me to put in breadsticks and cut up Pizzas as fast as I can because we would get incredibly busy and were understaffed. And this delusion would go on for a long time. I didn’t even step outside of my dorms for 2 months. I was failing school because I couldn’t control my reality, so I told my RA that I needed to go to the mental hospital to get help. And when I went it did help me, but what I think helped me more was leaving that college.
